name: 1- Download YouTube Chart

on:
  schedule:
    # Runs every Monday at 12:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 12 * * 1'
  
  # Allows manual triggering from the GitHub Actions UI
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  RETENTION_DAYS: 30

jobs:
  download-and-store:
    name: Download and Store YouTube Charts
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    # Timeout set to 15 minutes. Apify usually takes 30-60 seconds,
    # but this provides a safe buffer for network latency or queue times.
    timeout-minutes: 15
    
    permissions:
      contents: write
    
    steps:
    - name: 📚 Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        # Fetch full history to allow git rebase/pull operations in the commit step
        fetch-depth: 0
    
    - name: 🐍 Setup Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: "3.12"
        # Enable pip caching to speed up subsequent workflow runs
        cache: 'pip'
    
    - name: 📦 Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        # NOTE: We now rely on Apify for data extraction. 
        # We only need httpx to make the API request and pandas for data manipulation.
        pip install httpx pandas
    
    - name: 📁 Create directory structure
      run: |
        # Ensure all required directories exist before the script runs.
        # - data/: General output directory
        # - databases/: Weekly SQLite files (versioned by YYYY-WXX)
        # - backup/: Retention-managed backups of previous databases
        # - downloads/: Raw CSV output from the API
        mkdir -p data \
          charts_archive/1_download-chart/databases \
          charts_archive/1_download-chart/backup \
          charts_archive/1_download-chart/downloads
    
    - name: 🚀 Run download script
      run: |
        python scripts/1_download.py
      env:
        # Inject the Apify token from GitHub Secrets
        APIFY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.APIFY_TOKEN }}
        # Injects a flag to allow the script to detect it's running in a CI/CD environment
        GITHUB_ACTIONS: true
    
    - name: ✅ Verify results
      run: |
        echo "📊 Verifying execution results..."
        
        echo "📂 Contents of charts_archive/1_download-chart/:"
        ls -lah charts_archive/1_download-chart/
        
        echo -e "\n🗃️ Weekly databases:"
        ls -lah charts_archive/1_download-chart/databases/*.db 2>/dev/null || echo "No databases found"
        
        echo -e "\n💾 Backups:"
        ls -lah charts_archive/1_download-chart/backup/*.db 2>/dev/null || echo "No backups found"
        
        echo -e "\n📊 Latest CSV:"
        # Updated path to match the DOWNLOAD_DIR constant in the new script
        ls -lah charts_archive/1_download-chart/downloads/latest_chart.csv 2>/dev/null || echo "No CSV found"
        
        echo -e "\n📈 File statistics:"
        find charts_archive/1_download-chart -type f -exec ls -lh {} \; | awk '{print $5, $9}'
    
    - name: 📤 Commit and push changes
      run: |
        echo "📝 Preparing commit..."
        
        # Configure git identity for the automated commit
        git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
        git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
        
        # Stage only the archive directory to avoid committing unrelated changes
        git add charts_archive/
        
        # Check if there are staged changes; if not, skip commit to avoid empty commits
        if git diff --cached --quiet; then
          echo "🔭 No changes to commit"
        else
          DATE=$(date +'%Y-%m-%d')
          WEEK=$(date +'%Y-W%W')
          git commit -m "🤖 YouTube Chart Update ${DATE} (Week ${WEEK}) [Automated]"
          
          # Rebase to incorporate any upstream changes before pushing
          echo "⬇️ Pulling latest changes with rebase..."
          git pull --rebase origin main
          
          echo "⬆️ Pushing changes to repository..."
          git push origin HEAD:main
          echo "✅ Changes pushed successfully"
        fi
    
    - name: 📦 Upload artifacts (on failure)
      # Only upload artifacts if the job fails, to aid in debugging
      if: failure()
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: chart-debug-${{ github.run_number }}
        path: |
          data/
          charts_archive/
        retention-days: 7
    
    - name: 📋 Final report
      if: always()
      run: |
        echo "========================================"
        echo "🎵 FINAL EXECUTION REPORT"
        echo "========================================"
        echo "📅 Date: $(date)"
        echo "📌 Trigger: ${{ github.event_name }}"
        echo "🔗 Commit: ${{ github.sha }}"
        echo ""
        
        # Calculate current ISO week (YYYY-WXX) to verify database existence
        WEEK_ID=$(python3 -c "from datetime import datetime; y,w,_ = datetime.now().isocalendar(); print(f'{y}-W{w:02d}')")
        DB_FILE="charts_archive/1_download-chart/databases/youtube_charts_${WEEK_ID}.db"
        
        if [ -f "$DB_FILE" ]; then
          echo "✅ Weekly database updated: $DB_FILE"
          SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$DB_FILE")
          echo "📊 Size: $((SIZE / 1024)) KB"
        else
          echo "⚠️ Weekly database not found"
        fi
        
        if [ -f "charts_archive/1_download-chart/downloads/latest_chart.csv" ]; then
          echo "✅ Latest CSV updated"
          LATEST_SIZE=$(stat -c%s "charts_archive/1_download-chart/downloads/latest_chart.csv")
          echo "📊 Size: $((LATEST_SIZE / 1024)) KB"
        fi
        
        # Count historical databases to verify retention policy is working
        TOTAL_DBS=$(find charts_archive/1_download-chart/databases -name "youtube_charts_*.db" 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
        if [ "$TOTAL_DBS" -gt 0 ]; then
          echo ""
          echo "📦 Total historical databases: $TOTAL_DBS"
        fi
        
        # Count backups to verify the backup retention policy
        TOTAL_BACKUPS=$(find charts_archive/1_download-chart/backup -name "backup_*.db" 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
        if [ "$TOTAL_BACKUPS" -gt 0 ]; then
          echo "💾 Total available backups: $TOTAL_BACKUPS"
        fi
        
        echo ""
        echo "✅ Process completed"
        echo "========================================"
